fact: Decree-law 2020-31 of 10 June 2020 (JORT no. 54) enters into force on publication and gives a reliable electronic signature the same evidentiary force as a handwritten one and electronic documents the same force as paper (Arts 4, 6, 16).

fact: Law no. 2000-83 of 9 August 2000 on electronic exchanges and commerce, promulgated and published in the Journal Officiel no. 64 of 11 August 2000, gives electronic documents and signatures legal effect, creates the national electronic certification agency (ANCE), licenses certification providers and sets consumer rules for online sales (disclosure, 10-working-day withdrawal right, fines).
system: Loi n° 2000-83 relative aux échanges et au commerce électroniques
